nodes.label: ReactAgent
nodes.rationale: ReactAgent is the core reasoning pattern used in both RAG and SQL workflows; it handles the LLM↔tools loop until a final answer is produced, enabling multi-step agentic reasoning within a deterministic pipeline.

nodes.label: list_tables Deterministic Node
nodes.rationale: Uses a deterministic (non-LLM) node to create synthetic tool calls and return available table names. This avoids unnecessary LLM invocations for schema discovery, reducing cost and latency.

nodes.label: call_get_schema LLM Node
nodes.rationale: Uses LLM with forced tool choice to decide which table schema to retrieve, ensuring the model always calls sql_db_schema rather than producing free-form text.

nodes.label: generate_query ReactAgent Node
nodes.rationale: Hosts the main agentic reasoning loop; the ReactAgent iterates between LLM calls and sql_db_query tool invocations until a final answer is produced, with only SELECT queries allowed for safety.

nodes.label: H2 In-Memory Chinook Database
nodes.rationale: Uses H2 in-memory for zero-setup, reproducible demos. The Chinook schema mirrors a typical media store (artists, albums, tracks), providing realistic SQL query scenarios without external DB dependencies.

nodes.label: sql_db_query Tool (SELECT-only)
nodes.rationale: Restricted to SELECT queries only; no DML allowed. This safety constraint prevents the agent from accidentally modifying or deleting data.

nodes.label: Workflow Configuration Flags (rag.enabled, sql.enabled, runner.enabled)
nodes.rationale: Feature flags allow running RAG and SQL agents independently via Maven command-line arguments, enabling modular demos without code changes. The runner.enabled flag triggers an on-startup demo execution.
